svg.desc: Generated with MathJax 3.2.0 from this TeX (title, then body): \textbf{Listing 2}\quad \mathrm{D}{\small\mathrm{ECIDE}}(\mathcal{L}, q)\text{: the two prices of MM}\_\text{algo3} \begin{array}{rll} {\color{#8b949e}\scriptstyle 1} & S \gets (b_0 + a_0)/2;\ \ \textbf{if }\text{the top of the book is invalid }\textbf{then return }\text{no quote} & {\color{#8b949e}\scriptstyle \S\,4.1} \\[3pt] {\color{#8b949e}\scriptstyle 2} & \text{every }\Delta_s\text{ seconds add }(t, S)\text{ to the window; drop samples older than }W & \\[3pt] {\color{#8b949e}\scriptstyle 3} & \text{admissible} \gets \text{false},\quad m \gets 0 & \\[3pt] {\color{#8b949e}\scriptstyle 4} & \textbf{if }\text{the window holds at least 30 samples }\textbf{then} & {\color{#8b949e}\scriptstyle \S\,4.3} \\[3pt] {\color{#8b949e}\scriptstyle 5} & \hspace{1.4em}\text{fit }S_{k+1} = a + b\,S_k + e_k\text{ by least squares} & {\color{#8b949e}\scriptstyle \S\,4.4} \\[3pt] {\color{#8b949e}\scriptstyle 6} & \hspace{1.4em}\theta \gets -\ln b/\Delta t,\quad \mu \gets a/(1 - b),\quad t_{1/2} \gets \ln 2/\theta,\quad t \gets (b - 1)/\mathrm{se}(b) & \\[3pt] {\color{#8b949e}\scriptstyle 7} & \hspace{1.4em}\text{admissible} \gets 0 < b < 1\ \ \textbf{and}\ \ t \le -2.86\ \ \textbf{and}\ \ t_{\min} \le t_{1/2} \le t_{\max} & {\color{#8b949e}\scriptstyle \S\,4.5} \\[3pt] {\color{#8b949e}\scriptstyle 8} & \textbf{if }\text{admissible }\textbf{then }m \gets \mathrm{clip}\bigl((\mu - S)(1 - e^{-\theta\tau})/S,\ {-L},\ L\bigr)\quad\text{(the lean)} & {\color{#8b949e}\scriptstyle \S\,4.7} \\[3pt] {\color{#8b949e}\scriptstyle 9} & x \gets \mathrm{clip}\bigl((q - q_{\min})/(q_{\max} - q_{\min}),\ 0,\ 1\bigr) & {\color{#8b949e}\scriptstyle \S\,6.2} \\[3pt] {\color{#8b949e}\scriptstyle 10} & \kappa \gets\text{fitted on the fresh fill table, else }\kappa_0 & {\color{#8b949e}\scriptstyle \S\,6.1} \\[3pt] {\color{#8b949e}\scriptstyle 11} & \delta^+ \gets \max\bigl(\epsilon/S,\ 1/\kappa + m - \chi(2x - 1) + \varrho\bigr) + f & {\color{#8b949e}\scriptstyle \S\,6.2} \\[3pt] {\color{#8b949e}\scriptstyle 12} & \delta^- \gets \max\bigl(\epsilon/S,\ 1/\kappa - m + \chi(2x - 1) + \varrho\bigr) + f & \\[3pt] {\color{#8b949e}\scriptstyle 13} & A \gets \lceil \max(S(1 + \delta^+),\ b_0 + \epsilon) \rceil_\epsilon,\quad B \gets \lfloor \min(S(1 - \delta^-),\ a_0 - \epsilon) \rfloor_\epsilon & {\color{#8b949e}\scriptstyle \S\,6.3} \\[3pt] {\color{#8b949e}\scriptstyle 14} & \textbf{if }A/B \le 1 + G\textbf{ then} & {\color{#8b949e}\scriptstyle \S\,6.4} \\[3pt] {\color{#8b949e}\scriptstyle 15} & \hspace{1.4em}w \gets \max\bigl(((1 + G)B - A)/(2 + G),\ 0\bigr) + \epsilon,\quad B \gets \lfloor B - w \rfloor_\epsilon,\quad A \gets \lceil A + w \rceil_\epsilon & \\[3pt] {\color{#8b949e}\scriptstyle 16} & \textbf{if }B \ge A\textbf{ or }(1 - f)^2 A/B - 1 \le r\textbf{ then return }\text{no quote} & \\[3pt] {\color{#8b949e}\scriptstyle 17} & \textbf{if }\text{the last pair is within the requote band on both sides, younger than }T_r & {\color{#8b949e}\scriptstyle \S\,6.5} \\[3pt] {\color{#8b949e}\scriptstyle 18} & \hspace{1.4em}\text{and still above the bar }\textbf{then }(B, A) \gets\text{the last pair} & \\[3pt] {\color{#8b949e}\scriptstyle 19} & \textbf{return }(B, A) & \end{array}
